يلتمسون (form VIII)
# يَلْتَمِسُونَ (yaltamisūna) /jal.ta.mi.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# يُلْتَمَسُونَ (yultamasūna) /jul.ta.ma.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
